# Icons for TO DO, generated into src/apps_local/todo/TodoIcons.h by
# tools_local/todo/gen_todo_icons.sh. Format: alias = lucide-name, the same
# manifest shape as tools_local/toybox/icons.txt. Kept in the app's own folder
# rather than spliced into ToyboxIcons.h so the app adds nothing to a shared
# generated file.

# The shelf row. A list with a ticked box on it is what the app IS, and no
# other row on either shelf is built from a list.
todo      = list-todo

# The pinned mark on a list row, beside the "..." control. Lucide's pin is a
# thumbtack: a head, a stem and a point, three shapes that survive one bit at
# 24px where `pin-off`'s extra diagonal does not.
todo_pin  = pin

# The "..." control at the right of every list row. Three discs, the one
# glyph every touch UI already reads as "more actions".
todo_more = ellipsis
